## Capture rules

Use original synthetic data only. Begin capture after login; keep credentials, temporary
passwords, keys, cookies, auth codes, private references and private messages out of view.
Use existing completed evidence and software fixture checks; no paid generation/evaluation
is authorized by the recording schedule. Do not email, publish or upload the recording.
Save the video and a chapter/limitations manifest under ignored local artifacts, verify
playback and duration, then present the local output for review. Preserve existing videos.
